command: locks.sh iris python traces/crash_world.py $RUN_DIR/traces/crash (N=12000 relationships = 36,000 operations; container SIGKILL + start)
observes: Instance crash on IRIS 2026.1 Community (iris.cpf SynchCommit=0, the default). In-flight trial: commit running at the kill; after restart (16.6 s) nothing of it is visible, head 1, one revision row, statement/tuple consistent, verify equal (FR-047 all-or-nothing held); retry with the same key committed once (seq 2). Acknowledged trial: the client received seq 3, the container was killed at once; after restart (16.5 s) revision 3 and its 12,000 rows are gone entirely (head 2, consistent, verify equal); retry with the same key committed once (seq 3). Oracle check 'an acknowledged commit survives a crash' FAILED; consistency and exactly-once retry held in both trials.
